Under the hits, "Hits as document" and "Hits as table (CSV)" store the verses, and "Places on the map" shows where the places named are (bigger dot = more verses). Ctrl+K → "Reference network" shows the cross references between OT and NT books as a picture; a click on a book shows its verses. The clause search (under Analysis, grammar) finds Greek clauses by roles, e.g. subject Jesus and object Peter.

The editor works like a word processor: at the top paragraph style (headings, quote, lists), bold and italic (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I), horizontal rule, “＋ Verse” (type a passage and insert it as a quote or link), “[[ ]]” (link another document) and undo. Enter in a list continues it. “Read” (Ctrl+E) shows the finished page, in which verses and links can be clicked. It saves automatically; Ctrl+S saves at once. Print or save as PDF via “⋯”.
